answer: Clone fleets cannot share one cave thread. An applicant bonds 8.20 POA and is issued a single marble capstan at a reserved karst shaft for 14 minutes. They must pay out a 27.4 m survey thread, stamp a 17-bit drip-hash of shaft-id, pubkey, and epoch seed into the capstan, and seat it on the seed-drawn ledge in seconds 15-41. 96 aliases would freeze 787.20 POA and need 96 exclusive shafts. Auditors replay the shaft draw from the seed, regenerate the hash, and measure the thread to 0.08 m. A reused shaft, snapped thread, or hash clash burns 45% and seals that gallery for 7 epochs.
